messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need owners for SLO split, dashboards, and a prototype to detect cross-region bursts.
aj-ops: Agree. prefer staged canary and metric guards, not global toggles. :+1: 
sam: Suggested split: control-plane p95 < 1s (5m rolling), error budget on control-plane; inference SLO: 1h window, 99.5% latency < 300ms, fallback 99.0% during maintenance.
linh: Add a conservative burn-rate alert (10%/h) for control-plane. I can prototype cross-region burst detector. ETA 10 days.
ryan: I’ll update dashboards: compare old vs new windows, error-budget slope, and incident annotations. ETA 48h.
aj-ops: I’ll open config PR with canary flags; plan: staging 5%, prod 1% then 10% after 48h. ETA EOW.
maria: Action list: aj-ops (SLO config + canary) 3 business days; sam (inference SLO + rollback tests) 5 bd; ryan (dashboards + readme) 2 bd; linh (burst detector) 10 days.
sam: I’ll add a lightweight CI harness that repros KV-cache thrash to validate SLOs.
oncall-bot: Reminder: SLO review sync in 7 days — update tracker before meeting.
maria: Thanks — updating postmortem now. Ping here if anything slips. :white_check_mark:
